title.narrative: Scaling Up Innovative Approaches to Respond to TB Challenges and Strengthening Health Systems Initiatives in Afghanistan - Afghanistan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Afghanistan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Afghanistan)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality by 50% at the end of 2021 compared to 2015. To strengthen the health system to reduce mortality and morbidity associated with ATM and RMNCH. The objectives of this program are: To increase the case notification of all TB cases at least 8 % per year and to maintain treatment success rate at least 90% by 2021. To detect and treat at least 50% of estimated MDR-TB cases by 2021. To increase access of women and children to health care services for RMNCAH, HIV, TB and malaria, reduced stigma and discrimination and promotion of health lifestyles in the community and in health facilities in underserved areas. To maintain and improve the quality of the National Laboratory Network. To improve institutional capacity of Civil Society Organizations and private sector for effective implementation of TB, Malaria and HIV. To ensure high quality pharmaceuticals and health commodities by strengthening the supply chain, procurement, management, Quality Assurance and regulatory systems. To improve the data quality of the HMIS and strengthen the utilization of data for decision-making at all levels
